material.description: From the user: the well-known acronyms are never longer than 3 letters. Cap acronym() in scenarios/moba/panels.lua at 3: word initials; if more than 3, drop the stop words (of, the) first, then truncate to 3; one-word names keep their first three letters. heroAcronyms overrides still win and must each be at most 3 letters (check every existing override, including SHS, NAG, ESP, WK). Acceptance: every one of the 69 roster acronyms has length <= 3 and is unique; CI green. Ownership: panels.lua and moba_ui.json heroAcronyms.

notes.note: claimed by drain-closer-10; KOTL is the only table acronym over 3 letters (-> KL); overrides WK SHS NAG ESP are <=3; 69 acronyms unique once overrides apply
drain-closer-10 releases its claim (coordinator correction: row belongs to the panels lane). For the acronym row, 1f82aa06 on origin main caps KOTL to KL; ci green, pages pending when read.
